name: Salt and Sail
intro: Gullrock's an islet off the south-east coast - Factor Pell there pays half again what Westwatch does, and in Charter Seals besides. No road goes there. Take this rowboat deed; summon it at the water's edge. Two packs fit in her stern.

steps.text: Summon your rowboat at the shore
Deliver a trade pack to Factor Pell on Gullrock

outro: Rowed it yourself? Respect. Come back with a proper sloop and the sea will make you rich.
